frame: geographic-frame.json; existing anchor, metres and bearing unchanged
photos: Owner photographs IMG_0855-0866, 29 October 2026, inspected locally. None is shipped or used as a texture.
basis: Everything here is a visual estimate read from those photographs, placed against the existing mapped lanes and outlines. Nothing was surveyed.

apron.basis: 0855-0857: the junction in front of the Nishi gate is asphalt from wall to planting bed, with no lawn or sand footway.

asphaltLane.basis: 0855-0858: flush asphalt with gravel verges; the inherited sand shoulders are retiled, not resized.

nishiCypress.basis: 0990, 0997: a tall leaning cypress row behind the low stone wall, with bare trunks at its foot. Height estimated.

diamonds.basis: 0980, 1004: teal crossing-ahead diamond with a white frame, in the left lane. Size estimated.

cypress.basis: 0857-0860: a tall dark clipped cypress screen behind a rusted white fence on a concrete block footing.

junctionBed.basis: 0858: a log-edged raised bed with a cut-back cherry, a no-parking sign reading 区域内, and a thin rusted pole.

villa.basis: 0858-0860: grey two-storey building with a hipped slate roof, chimney and arched door beyond the open lot. Distance estimated from its apparent size, so its position is uncertain by about 15 m.

samuraiWall.basis: 0863: mortared stone base, grey plaster, tile coping and a white end wall, on the right of the road east of the bend.

rampart.basis: 0866: continuous stone rampart at the foot of the wooded bank. Height estimated; the retained bank line is not re-registered.

schoolPlanting.basis: 0864-0865: clipped azaleas in a kerbed bed with chain posts, paired steles, fan palms, a tall hedge and a dark direction post.

limits: The moat, inner road and bank here are the retained satellite trace. OSM way/121393441, which fits 0862's GPS, runs about 20 m south of it, so 0862 cannot be matched from its recorded position; the road was not moved.
Species are silhouette recipes, not botanical identification.
Signs and notices are simplified readable graphics of what the photographs show, not verified regulations; unreadable text is not transcribed.
